task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

excluded_cohorts: From Published Evidence to Analyzable Biomedical Cohorts

model.interpretation: A fixed hypothetical joint law transported to the declared weighted complete-case analytical population. Equal-weight generated rows approximate this law, not a recovered PNS dataset or an identified national distribution.

errors.construction: For independent standard normals z1,z2 and q distributed chi-square(7), use sqrt(5/q) times [16*z1, 10*(0.5*z1+sqrt(0.75)*z2)].

bp.rejection_rule: Keep age, sex and BMI fixed; independently redraw the paired BP errors until both BP values and their difference satisfy the bounds. This defines a conditional distribution, not cohort-wide exclusion.

model.parameter_uncertainty: All parameters are fixed scenario choices. Source coefficient SEs are not treated as transport uncertainty or as person-level variation.
